snapshots.name: Pinocchio
snapshots.subtitle: A wooden puppet
snapshots.body: A puppet Geppetto carves from a log that could already talk and cry. He is quick, cheeky and easily led, makes good resolutions and forgets them, and when he lies his nose grows.
snapshots.editorialBasis: Reviewed baseline identity at first mention; no concealed identity or later plot development.

snapshots.name: Geppetto
snapshots.subtitle: A poor old woodcarver, Pinocchio's maker
snapshots.body: A lively, quick-tempered old man in a yellow wig, whom the neighbourhood boys tease by calling him Polendina, after a yellow cornmeal porridge. He carves the puppet to earn a living with him and treats him as his son.
snapshots.editorialBasis: Reviewed baseline identity at first mention; no concealed identity or later plot development.

snapshots.name: Master Cherry
snapshots.subtitle: An old carpenter
snapshots.body: A carpenter whose real name is Master Antonio, nicknamed for the shiny red tip of his nose. The talking piece of wood turns up in his workshop first, and it frightens him so badly that he gives it away.
snapshots.editorialBasis: Reviewed baseline identity at first mention; no concealed identity or later plot development.

snapshots.name: The Talking Cricket
snapshots.subtitle: A cricket who lives in Geppetto's room
snapshots.body: An old cricket who says he has lived in Geppetto's room for more than a hundred years. He tells Pinocchio plainly what happens to boys who disobey and run away, which the puppet does not want to hear.
snapshots.editorialBasis: Reviewed baseline identity at first mention; no concealed identity or later plot development.

snapshots.name: The Fairy with the blue hair
snapshots.subtitle: A Fairy who lives in a little white house in the wood
snapshots.body: A pale girl with blue hair at the window of a house in the wood, who is in fact a good Fairy. She takes the puppet in when he is in danger and treats him with both kindness and firmness.
snapshots.editorialBasis: Reviewed baseline identity at first mention; no concealed identity or later plot development.

snapshots.name: The Fox
snapshots.subtitle: A Fox who limps along the road
snapshots.body: A Fox who appears to be lame in one foot and travels with a Cat. He is friendly, flattering and very interested in the gold coins Pinocchio is carrying home.
snapshots.editorialBasis: Reviewed baseline identity at first mention; no concealed identity or later plot development.

snapshots.name: The Cat
snapshots.subtitle: The Fox's companion
snapshots.body: A Cat who appears to be blind in both eyes and leans on the Fox as they walk. She mostly repeats whatever the Fox says.
snapshots.editorialBasis: Reviewed baseline identity at first mention; no concealed identity or later plot development.

snapshots.name: Fire-Eater
snapshots.subtitle: The owner of the puppet theatre
snapshots.body: The puppet master who runs the theatre, with a huge black beard that covers his chest and legs like an apron. He looks terrifying, but he is not really a bad man, and when he is moved he sneezes.
snapshots.editorialBasis: Reviewed baseline identity at first mention; no concealed identity or later plot development.

snapshots.name: Harlequin
snapshots.subtitle: A puppet in the travelling theatre
snapshots.body: One of the stock comic characters of the puppet theatre, who recognises Pinocchio from the stage and greets him as a brother.
snapshots.editorialBasis: Reviewed baseline identity at first mention; no concealed identity or later plot development.

snapshots.name: Punchinello
snapshots.subtitle: A puppet in the travelling theatre
snapshots.body: Harlequin's quarrelsome partner on the stage of the puppet theatre.
snapshots.editorialBasis: Reviewed baseline identity at first mention; no concealed identity or later plot development.

snapshots.name: Medoro
snapshots.subtitle: The Fairy's Poodle
snapshots.body: A magnificent Poodle in a coachman's uniform who serves the Fairy and walks upright on his hind legs, exactly like a man.
snapshots.editorialBasis: Reviewed baseline identity at first mention; no concealed identity or later plot development.

snapshots.name: Melampo
snapshots.subtitle: A farmer's watchdog
snapshots.body: The dog who used to guard a farmer's henhouse at night.
snapshots.editorialBasis: Reviewed baseline identity at first mention; no concealed identity or later plot development.

snapshots.name: The Pigeon
snapshots.subtitle: A large Pigeon who has seen Geppetto
snapshots.body: A large Pigeon who calls down to Pinocchio from the sky, with news of an old man making himself a little boat to cross the ocean.
snapshots.editorialBasis: Reviewed baseline identity at first mention; no concealed identity or later plot development.

snapshots.name: The Snail
snapshots.subtitle: A Snail in the Fairy's service
snapshots.body: A large Snail with a little lamp on her head who answers the door of the Fairy's house, very slowly.
snapshots.editorialBasis: Reviewed baseline identity at first mention; no concealed identity or later plot development.

snapshots.name: Candlewick
snapshots.subtitle: Pinocchio's favourite schoolmate
snapshots.body: A thin, dry, lanky boy whose real name is Romeo, called Candlewick because he looks like a new wick. He is the laziest and naughtiest boy in the whole school, and Pinocchio's dearest friend.
snapshots.editorialBasis: Reviewed baseline identity at first mention; no concealed identity or later plot development.

snapshots.name: Alidoro
snapshots.subtitle: A police mastiff
snapshots.body: A large mastiff who has won first prize in every dog race, set on Pinocchio's trail by the police.
snapshots.editorialBasis: Reviewed baseline identity at first mention; no concealed identity or later plot development.

snapshots.name: The Tuna
snapshots.subtitle: A Tuna swallowed by the Shark
snapshots.body: A Tuna who has been swallowed by the Shark and tries to take it calmly, consoling himself that a Tuna dying in water is more honourable than one dying in oil.
snapshots.editorialBasis: Reviewed baseline identity at first mention; no concealed identity or later plot development.

snapshots.name: The Shark
snapshots.subtitle: A sea monster
snapshots.body: A terrible Shark, said to be as big as a five-storey house, who has come to the coast to spread death and misery through the waters.
snapshots.editorialBasis: Reviewed baseline identity at first mention; no concealed identity or later plot development.
